name: Animal Flow | Main Mission x Mahindra | 29TH NOV
description:
ABOUT THIS EVENT

Start your Sunday moving with Main Mission x Mahindra. Join us for Animal Flow at Depot 18 on Sunday, 29 November at 7:00 AM, followed by free coffee at Lavonne. A morning of movement, coffee and giveaways for everyone.

---

WHAT TO EXPECT

Start with an Animal Flow session at Depot 18, with Hydrasalt hydration on the house. After the session, head to Lavonne for free coffee. There's also 10% off food and giveaways for everyone.

---

WHO IS THIS FOR

For those looking to spend their Sunday morning moving and connecting with the community. Bring your own mat.

---

WHAT'S INCLUDED

- Animal Flow session

- Free post-session coffee at Lavonne

- Hydrasalt hydration on the house

- 10% off food

- Giveaways for everyone
